title: Vuu-do 20261015
content:
Vuu-do is a minimalist desktop Linux distribution featuring primarily the Openbox window manager. Despite its small size, the distribution ships with several popular productivity applications, such as LibreOffice, GIMP, Inkscape, VLC and Transmission, as well as various custom utilities, including VuuNotes (a lightweight note-taking application), VuuMan (a graphical man-page browser and viewer), VuuPaper (a wallpaper manager). Vuu-do can be installed to a hard disk using the Refracta system installer. Besides the main branch, the project also builds a separate Devuan-based ISO image using the Xlibre X11 display server and the MATE desktop environment.
